title: Kagamine Len — My Own Way Of Being Cool!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: My Own Way Of Being Cool!（3★）
meta.Event: Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? Did someone just arrive...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey! Let's do our best again during practice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hang on. Where are Ichika and Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They both have work today, but they said that they should be able to make it in time for practice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, right. They mentioned that during practice yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, wanna chat for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've actually been doing some drawing since we last spoke.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?!
Does this mean I get to see what you drew?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Of course. If anything, I want to show you. And here it is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-Whaaat?!
Is this a synth?! It's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've always liked the way all the knobs and switches on synthesizers look.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, I ended up really focusing on how they look more than the keyboard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, you captured its characteristics so well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I dunno if it's because of how detailed it is, but my eyes are just naturally drawn to those parts.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I'm already working on drawing the next set of instruments. Here, it's a drum kit...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, this looks really cool too!
I bet these drums sound amazing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too! And I really like the top-down angle you chose here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I thought a lot about what the best and coolest angle would be for these.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: After a few laps of walking around a drum kit, I figured it out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: As it turns out, the best angle seems to be from straight above.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. Your overall design is very impressive, but I'm astonished at the amount of thought that's gone into this drawing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nah, this is just me wanting to draw a really cool drum kit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, the snare and bass drum aren't exactly to scale.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that may be, but I really do think that these drums look very cool.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... I kinda feel like drawing now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Honami, didn't you paint a wall together with everyone during your job shadowing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, wanna paint one of this school's walls?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds like fun!
Especially since it'd be like us doodling where we're not supposed to!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Doodling is probably against the rules...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, I think we all had fun when Luka suggested that we draw all over one of the chalkboards.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That means we get to draw all we want since there are so many chalkboards here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna do that thing where you take a bucket of paint and splash it against a wall!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, what?! People do that?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I saw someone doing it in a video the other day♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They even covered themselves in paint and rolled around like a human paint roller!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They made handprints and footprints too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow...!
That sounds like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we did that in a classroom, it'd probably become a huge mess... So, let's try doing it outside when it's nice and sunny!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! We should be able to do that whenever since the weather in SEKAI is always nice! When it showers, it's usually just stars.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Hona, let's do it!
Len's in, so you're in too, right?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We should let Ichika, Shiho, Miku and everyone else about this too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I'll tell Miku and the others!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll start with Rin and MEIKO.
Those two should be all for your idea.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: After that, if I ask KAITO, Miku and Luka in that order, then we should be all set!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That means we should talk to Ichi first, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, we'll beg Shiho to join us♪
I'm sure she'll cave if we ask her over and over again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-You want to do this that much...?

rows.Speaker: Len & Saki
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, Saki, let's do our best to get the others to join in!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
